description: Several brightly colored plastic plates and utensils are spread across the tabletop, with a yellow bottle near the center. The right hand holds a blue sponge and the left hand holds a blue spoon; the left hand brings the spoon toward the sponge while the right hand steadies it, rubbing the spoon’s bowl and handle against the sponge as if scrubbing, then both hands lower and release the spoon and sponge onto the table.
